reviewMethod: Actually independently read all174 entire bilingual pairs and all200 complete frozen objects joined to their entire retained row or scoped author-deferral entry in five untruncated candidate groups 1–40,41–80,81–120,121–160,161–200. Read every complete Chinese definition, source POS, variant, rank and source-evidence field plus all26 author exclusions and root-decision-p065.json. Assessed selected-sense/POS, English grammar and naturalness, Chinese entailment, register and actual head occurrence. Primary publisher checks for peepbo, orang-utang, palmcorder, piped music and preteen are recorded with actual read scopes in the initial findings; retrieval failures were not treated as evidence of invalidity. The one substantive precision finding was the biological-stage Chinese reading of pre-teen. Root explicitly authorized an age-based clarification within the frozen age alternative, without canonical-source replacement; E actually reread the final complete five-field pre-teen pair and all its frozen source context, confirming that the Chinese now says under thirteen rather than assuming absence of puberty. E independently byte-verified the other173 entire rows, all174 English/head/POS fields, full order and terminal LF unchanged, reversed the permitted changed row to the original raw hash, and verified all200 frozen bytes, all26 scoped author deferrals and the author decision unchanged. After root's fresh compilation E independently recomputed the exact supplied source hash and raw/LOCK hash and verified all174 compiled five-field objects exactly match the final locked TSV. No other known substantive errors remain in these174 pairs. All26 author exclusions remain unapproved backlog. No reviewer-authored replacement, sampled approval, self-review, canonical-definition change or publication is implied; mechanical checks only establish provenance and freshness.
